title: Country I-IV-V Clean Practice
purpose: Support hybrid picking, alternating bass, double-stops, chord-tone targeting, muting, and pedal-steel-style bends in a clean country context.
feel: clean straight country with boom-chuck space and a simple turnaround

tracks.name: Drums
tracks.instrument_intent: restrained country kit emphasizing stable backbeat and clean guitar articulation

tracks.name: Bass
tracks.instrument_intent: simple root-and-fifth electric bass supporting boom-chuck practice

tracks.name: Keys
tracks.instrument_intent: very light piano chord support; leave upper strings open for double-stops and bends

provenance.notes: Original I-IV-V country practice form using common functional harmony.
